item.text: {"search_note":"I found no reliable 2024 evidence of a broader post-conflict reconciliation process, formal settlement initiative, or sustained bilateral peace track outside the Gaza ceasefire file.\nI also found no evidence that Sisi refused ceasefire or peace-talk opportunities when they were available.\nThe strongest and most consistent 2024 pattern is ceasefire-first diplomacy on Gaza, not a larger peace process.","evidence":[{"title":"President El-Sisi and Jordan’s King Abdullah II Hold Talks in Amman","publisher":"Presidency of the Republic of Egypt","date":"2024-04-01","url":"https://www.presidency.eg/en/%D9%82%D8%B3%D9%85_%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D8%AE%D8%A8%D8%A7%D8%B1/%D8%A3%D8%AE%D8%A8%D8%A7%D8%B1_%D8%B1%D8%A6%D8%A7%D8%B3%D9%8A%D8%A9/new142024-2/","summary":"Sisi and Abdullah II called for an immediate Gaza ceasefire and warned that any military operation in Rafah would have grave consequences. This is direct evidence of pursuing ceasefire and avoiding escalation when alternatives existed.","question_ids":["2B.7","2B.1","2B.4"]},{"title":"President El-Sisi Meets the CIA Director","publisher":"Presidency of the Republic of Egypt","date":"2024-04-07","url":"https://www.presidency.eg/en/%D9%82%D8%B3%D9%85_%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D8%AE%D8%A8%D8%A7%D8%B1/%D8%A3%D8%AE%D8%A8%D8%A7%D8%B1_%D8%B1%D8%A6%D8%A7%D8%B3%D9%8A%D8%A9/news742024/","summary":"The discussion centered on Egyptian-Qatari-American ceasefire efforts, civilian protection, rejecting displacement, and preventing the conflict from widening. This is domestic coercion, not reconciliation, and it limits confidence in the regime’s broader restraint.","question_ids":["2B.7","2B.3","1B.5"]}]}
